opening: Lord, meet us gently today and always
body:
For me, this verse is a reminder that Christ is always drawing near. He comes in His Word, in the Eucharist, in moments of grace, and one day He will come again in glory. Until then, we continue the work He has given us, trusting that He is already ahead of us.

St. Paul wrote:

“So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God, who causes the growth.”

That fits well with Matthew 10. We labor faithfully, but the harvest belongs to Christ. Amen!!🙏🏼
